description.p: Capy on Flathub. A clicked capy:// link no longer stops Capy at launch, the minutes show each action item whole, counts say one decision or task, and a call with cameras on is called a video call.

Capy is for private meetings between people who invite each other. Rooms replicate directly between participants, with no servers and no accounts, and everything the AI does runs on your own computer.

ul.li: Invite-only rooms: a member lets each new person in
Messages, files, voice and video messages, kept on the members' devices
Audio and video calls, screen sharing and a shared whiteboard
After a call: a transcript by speaker, a summary and speaking insights, made on this computer
One identity from 24 words, on as many devices as you like
